value.rationale: The Lamé family is a natural fundamental family joining diamond, astroid and disk geometries. Isolated diameter pairs force continuously varying sharp probability powers and Dirichlet marks, whereas a continuum of circular diameter directions produces the exceptional 5/2 power. The derived joint scaling law resolves the crossover and exhibits a sharp topological transition from all angles to four axial arcs, with an explicit large-parameter logarithmic localization, relevant to random diameter events and geometric statistical shape recovery.
